question: Does a fixed local building region give a sufficiently accurate displacement and stable choice between232/474?
hypothesis: Global fit mixes depths. Local building translation may be accurate enough, but competition may remain sensitive within heldout error.
method: Follow-up after global readiness failure; old result retained. Choose a single facade region from the already inspected scene:880,405,1135,475. This is a nearby background surface, not proved equal depth to car. Same detector/target masks and LK parameters, minDistance4, checkerboard20px. Fit translation as componentwise training median, evaluate independent held-out grid cells. No alternate region/model search. Full and residual translations, target-only/all-row and reverse controls as before. Assess all-row sensitivity on a preregistered5x5 displacement grid spanning plus/minus maximum heldout90th percentile of both transitions, for full and residual; empirical diagnostics only.
acceptance: All input hashes and baseline costs/assignment exactly reproduce.

Both transitions have at least20 train and20 heldout points, heldout median<=1px and90th percentile<=2px. This stricter error criterion is fixed before measuring local motion; count adjusted to fixed small spatial region. No region search after failure.
Report both winner and sensitivity to registered errors at unchanged0.8. No learned model or full tracker.
limits: Background transform is an image-motion estimate, not external camera pose. Dynamic unmasked objects, parallax and depth may remain. No direct GT annotation at539; even restored assignment cannot prove true identity. Camera correction is an isolated counterfactual, not unique physical cause. Literature BoT-SORT https://arxiv.org/abs/2206.14651 supports mechanism only.
